component.name: Dena.emu
component.summary: Play your own retro games with a controller or a mouse

description.p: Dena.emu is a multi-system emulator with a console-style interface that works with a controller, a keyboard or a mouse. It starts in fullscreen when a controller is connected, so it is at home on the Steam Deck and on a TV.

ul.li: Game Boy, Game Boy Color, Game Boy Advance, DS

description.p: Features include a box-art library with watched game folders, save states, auto-save and resume, rewind, fast-forward, cheats, RetroAchievements and RomM server support.
No games or BIOS files are included. Use your own legally obtained copies.
Zipped .cue and .bin disc games now import, one game per disc, with missing tracks named in the error.
First stable release: Brutalist redesign, twelve desktop cores, netplay, controller profiles, shader stacks and the ROM manager.
Desktop test build for Windows and the Steam Deck: x86_64 cores, controller-first fullscreen, watched game folders.
First Linux desktop and Steam Deck build.
